payload.title: Attach custom domains to web and API CloudFront distributions
payload.description:
After routing decision and certificates: Route 53 A/AAAA alias records from chattic.us (and env subdomains) to the web distribution; API hostname to the matching thin-turn distribution if using a subdomain.

Update python/src/chatticus/cloud_environments.py pinned URLs only as fallbacks; prefer SSM discovery.

Verify HTTPS redirect and that SSE reconnect (Last-Event-ID) works through the chosen path — exercise with scripts/exercise_thin_turn.py or a browser acceptance check.
